notes: Second regional increment after the Americas (captive_power/americas-all). Scope = the 28-country list from batches/staging/europe/meta.json, adopted verbatim so the coverage ledger stays consistent (Russia, Turkiye and Cyprus count as Europe here). 144 terminals / 210 unit rows, all 28 countries represented. Filtered on Country/Area with GOGPT loaded by_country=True, deliberately NOT --subnational, so the blank-State/Province blind spot (10 European terminals, plus blank-subnational GOGPT plants) cannot silently drop rows. All 144 terminals have coordinates. CaptiveGasPower is blank on all 144 going in, so no existing citations to merge on the value half. Deterministic priors: 66 colocation priors, 429 neighbour rows, 336 unmatched GOGPT captive plants. Terminal-first crawl sharded 18 ways, then FOUR further sweeps (see below). FIRST-BUILD OUTCOME (2026-07-27): 30 confirmed captive terminals -> 57 CaptiveGasPower unit-rows staged, 50 green / 7 yellow, 13 mechanical=True. 46 documented NO, 57 INSUFFICIENT, 7 SCREENED, 4 STANDBY_ONLY. FINAL OUTCOME (2026-07-28 rebuild, see the standby reversal at the end of this note): 34 confirmed terminals -> 64 CaptiveGasPower unit-rows, zero STANDBY_ONLY remaining. Zero PowerPlantsSupplied (asserted in assembler + verified in QC scan). 147 qa_review items (3 high / 101 medium / 43 low). THE FIRST-PASS CONCLUSION WAS WRONG AND IS RETRACTED: the initial crawl found 5 YES (Norway 1 + Russia 4) and concluded 'ZERO in the EU or UK, because captive power is a liquefaction phenomenon and Europe's fleet is overwhelmingly grid-connected import/regas.' That reasoning was the abolished >50 MW floor wearing a geographic disguise. The true count is 30 across 13 countries, and 11 of them are EU/Turkiye: Belgium, Croatia, Cyprus, France, Germany(3), Greece(2), Italy(8), Lithuania, Poland, Romania, Turkiye. Two classes carry it: (i) FSRUs, whose onboard dual-fuel gensets ARE captive gas power (Krk, Cyprus, Le Havre, Brunsbuttel, Mukran, Wilhelmshaven, Alexandroupolis, Piombino, Toscana, Klaipeda, Marshal Vasilevskiy, Polish Baltic, Etki) -- the single largest miss class, an import-side phenomenon the liquefaction theory ruled out a priori; and (ii) small/mid Italian and Greek regas terminals running BOG-fired engines or cogeneration (Ravenna, HIGAS, Gioia Tauro, Revithoussa, Zeebrugge's WKK). FOUR SWEEPS WERE NEEDED, and the last two mattered most. Sweep 3/4 re-audited the SCREENED class itself -- a screen is a verdict with NO research behind it and is invisible to every verdict sweep. Of 36 screened records, 23 were never built (screen stands) and 13 were built (scale is not a screen). Re-researching them produced Ravenna (a green YES: three BOG-fired MCI generating the depot's own electricity, per the MASE filing) and HIGAS Sardinia (Riviera's as-built list says 'a natural gas captive power generation system' verbatim). The SOP's Phase-2 dispatch text that generated the error -- it told the dispatcher to quick-screen 'small import/FSRU regas terminals' -- has been fixed at source in docs/sops/captive_power.md, so the next area increment cannot repeat it. QC GATE (all rounds): dropped nsenergybusiness.com/projects/hammerfest-lng (403 AND no Wayback = unverifiable); Ust-Luga green->yellow (one document, vendor release is not primary); Arctic LNG 2 electric_mw prose->1500, its 4 refs are really 2 publishers; 7 inline gem.wiki URLs scrubbed from prose fields; Hammerfest gogpt_candidate ADD->DO NOT ADD; Antifer's proposed NO upgrade REJECTED (the CNDP dossier's 'turbine a gaz entrainant l'alternateur' is a glossary footnote defining 'cycle combine', not site equipment) and kept INSUFFICIENT; Brunsbuttel-onshore NO->INSUFFICIENT (a 2018 conference deck and an adversarial climate Gutachten are not permitted-emission-source enumerations, so their silence is bare absence); Kollsnes YES->NO (an INFERRED mechanical-drive yes loses to Gasnor's own permit, whose entire energy plant is 2.05 MWt of hot-oil burners); Gran Canaria and Bar INSUFFICIENT->SCREENED, now EVIDENCED as never-built rather than assumed; ROUND 4 audited the six YES terminals resting on a SINGLE citation (green on a lone source is legitimate only when that source is primary/regulatory AND states the value) -- five pass (Zeebrugge's Flemish ministerial decree; the Gioia Tauro / Trieste Monfalcone / Zaule MASE VIA filings; DESFA's own fact sheet, which says 'supplying the necessary power to LNG terminal' verbatim) and Etki was downgraded green->yellow, because its lone operator spec page never states self-generation, it states 'Engine: Wartsila-Hyundai DFDE' and the finding is one inferential step from that designation. REVIEWER DECISION POINT: 8 of the 30 YES terminals are staged on AS-DESIGNED evidence for facilities that are not currently operating -- 4 wholly cancelled (Constanta, Shtokman, Trieste Monfalcone, Zaule), 1 shelved (Cyprus FSRU), 2 proposed (Gioia Tauro, Obsky), 1 retired (Le Havre FSRU) -- plus Marshal Vasilevskiy idled. Staging them is consistent with how GEM retains every other as-designed attribute (Capacity, Owner, FacilityType) on a dead record, and the evidence is the project's own filing; but if the reviewer reads CaptiveGasPower as strictly as-built/current-state, those are the rows to drop. ORCHESTRATOR-RESOLVED after shards gave up: Montoir INSUFFICIENT->STANDBY_ONLY and Panigaglia INSUFFICIENT->NO, both by reading documents the shards could not open -- Montoir's 33-page 1997 base authorisation is an image-only scan, OCR'd via the new pdftoppm+tesseract fallback in url_verifier.py, and its Article I-2 enumerates '1 groupe electrogene gaz de secours d'une puissance de 1 250 kVA' (gas-fired, but emergency-only, so not staged); Panigaglia's 263-page Studio Preliminare Ambientale states the site takes 132 kV from the national grid and that the 32 MW cogeneration authorised by DM 569/2010 was never built. GOGPT-side: Hammerfest plant_id 100000407847 has captive=false which is WRONG; Yamal + Sakhalin II have NO GOGPT record; no European GOGPT plant carries the id-56 liquefaction captive tag. GOTCHA: an override keyed to a nonexistent terminal_id silently no-ops -- the Ust-Luga downgrade was keyed to T100000130846 (does not exist; correct T100000130504) and only the assembler's SKIPPED warning caught it. RESIDUAL DEBT: 57 INSUFFICIENT, of which 5 failed only on document retrieval and are worth one more attempt (Pori and Klaipeda-small-scale each FOUND an enumeration that then failed url_verifier on a 403 with no Wayback; Mosjoen blocked by an invalid TLS cert on gasnor.no; Fredrikstad by a docplayer-only mirror; Brunnsviksholme's miljotillstand unobtained). Brunsbuttel onshore has a live lead: the Schleswig-Holstein portal (G10/2023/055) advertised a March-2026 participation window, now four months past, so the Antragsunterlagen are probably downloadable. ESCALATED: Black Sea LNG T100000131101 tagged Romania but coordinates land at Kulevi, Georgia, 765 m from T100000130910. REBUILT 2026-07-28 (standby policy reversal + hardware taxonomy). User directive: "if there is any turbine whatsoever that runs when grid supply fails, that counts as a yes." This REVERSES the current-state disposition rule settled in this very pass the day before — the rule that produced the four STANDBY_ONLY verdicts — and SOP §2b was rewritten accordingly: standby duty now decides the captive_category, not the value. The fuel gate survives, which is what keeps the flip list short and defensible: gas-fired standby flips to YES, diesel-only standby stays NO, and unstated fuel stays INSUFFICIENT (Rostock and Southern Finland were re-checked and stay INSUFFICIENT for exactly that reason). Europe consequences: +7 unit-rows, 57 -> 64, all GREEN, across four terminals — Eemshaven (3 rows), Montoir (2 rows), Taranto (1 row), Zeeland ZET (1 row). Montoir is the one that vindicates the OCR work described above: the same Article I-2 line that made it STANDBY_ONLY ('1 groupe électrogène gaz de secours d'une puissance de 1 250 kVA') is now the citation for a green True. Its second georisques URL (/details/0006300974) was deliberately dropped from ref_urls — it passes url_verifier on 'MONTOIR' but contains none of the generating-plant text, so it is not evidence for this value; the reason is recorded in the record's source_notes. Klaipeda is the type case now written into SOP §2b (a standby-capable FSRU genset that also carries load = power_generation, not standby_backup). ALSO NEW: every staged record now carries captive_category + hardware_summary (SOP §2d), the two review-only PER-UNIT-ROW columns the user asked to sit left-most in updates_in_database_format — five-value taxonomy plus a one-line hardware description grounded in that record's already-verified source_notes. Europe split: 44 power_generation / 7 mechanical_drive / 7 standby_backup / 6 both.
